title: The relative-Spec conormal zero section pulls back by augmentation
statement: Let $s:S\hookrightarrow V$ be a closed immersion. Let $G_s$ be the conormal algebra, $\epsilon:G_s\to\mathcal O_S$ its augmentation, $p:C_s\to S$ its relative spectrum and $z:S\to C_s$ the section induced contravariantly by $\epsilon$ [def-pur-normal-bundle]. Let $c:G_s\simeq p_*\mathcal O_{C_s}$ be the canonical counit identification [def-pur-rees-cone-normalization]. For every open $U\subseteq S$, the composite $G_s(U)\xrightarrow{c_U}\Gamma(p^{-1}U,\mathcal O_{C_s})\xrightarrow{z^\sharp}\Gamma(U,\mathcal O_S)$ is $\epsilon_U$.

source.place: Lemma 01LX, the relative-Spec anti-equivalence, together with divisors.tex definition-conormal-sheaf (0630) and the degree-zero augmentation.

proof.text: The chosen anti-equivalence sends the defined section to the counit followed by augmentationToBase, by map_preimage. Apply its morphism-on-sections formula and cancel the inverse counit defining the canonical algebra identification. At the base end, the under-category triangle identifies the transported structural map with the identity. Object equality transports cancel, leaving the augmentation map on every open.

theorem coneZeroSection_app {V S : Scheme.{u}} (s : S ⟶ V)
    [IsClosedImmersion s] (U : S.Opens) :
    (coneAlgebraIso s).hom.right.hom.app (op U) ≫
      (PurityNormalBundle.zeroSection s).appLE (PurityNormalBundle.projection s ⁻¹ᵁ U) U
        (by rw [← Scheme.Hom.comp_preimage, (PurityNormalBundle.zeroSection_spec s).1]; simp) =
      (ConormalGradedAlgebra.augmentation s).right.hom.app (op U)
